Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA)

Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) focuses on ensuring that clinical trials are conducted in compliance with FDA regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and internal quality standards. CQA provides independent oversight of clinical activities to protect patient safety and data integrity.

CQA activities typically span the full clinical lifecycle, including study startup, conduct, and closeout. Effective clinical quality oversight helps identify risks early, supports consistent trial execution, and ensures issues are addressed before they impact regulatory submissions.

Strong CQA programs support inspection readiness and contribute to reliable, high-quality clinical data.

Clinical quality assurance activities commonly include:

Clinical system and process audits

Study-level and program-level oversight

Site and vendor audit support

GCP compliance assessments

CAPA development and follow-up
